fields.q: 当佣兵其实没那么难。飞过战场的话，说不定能看到他们打仗！
fields.en: It's not too hard to be a merc, really. Fly over a battlefield, and maybe you'll see some in action!
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 当佣兵其实没那么难。飞过战场的话，说不定能看到他们打仗！

en.value: It's not too hard to be a merc, really. Fly over a battlefield, and maybe you'll see some in action!

fields.q: 爱打听的人真让我受不了。你懂我的意思吧？
fields.en: Nosy people drive me up the wall. You know what I mean?
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 爱打听的人真让我受不了。你懂我的意思吧？

en.value: Nosy people drive me up the wall. You know what I mean?

fields.q: 我祖上来自达马斯卡，不代表我也信奉尤法斯。
fields.en: Just because my ancestors were from Damascar doesn't mean I pray to Yu Phas too.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 我祖上来自达马斯卡，不代表我也信奉尤法斯。

en.value: Just because my ancestors were from Damascar doesn't mean I pray to Yu Phas too.

fields.q: 要是能从一个战场飞到另一个战场？老兄，那才叫生活。
fields.en: Now, if I could fly from battlefield to battlefield? Man, that would be the life.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 要是能从一个战场飞到另一个战场？老兄，那才叫生活。

en.value: Now, if I could fly from battlefield to battlefield? Man, that would be the life.

fields.q: 你真是个怪家伙，对吧？想活得久的动物通常都更小心。
fields.en: You're a strange one, aren't you? An animal that cares about living longer is usually more careful.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 你真是个怪家伙，对吧？想活得久的动物通常都更小心。

en.value: You're a strange one, aren't you? An animal that cares about living longer is usually more careful.

fields.q: 会飞的话，偷袭大概更容易吧？只要附近没有弓箭手。
fields.en: Launching a surprise attack is probably easier if you can fly, huh? As long as no archers are around.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 会飞的话，偷袭大概更容易吧？只要附近没有弓箭手。

en.value: Launching a surprise attack is probably easier if you can fly, huh? As long as no archers are around.

fields.q: 有时候就算不在战场上，我也会觉得……浑身紧绷，你懂吧？
fields.en: Sometimes, even when I'm not on the battlefield, I feel this… tension in me, you know?
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 有时候就算不在战场上，我也会觉得……浑身紧绷，你懂吧？

en.value: Sometimes, even when I'm not on the battlefield, I feel this… tension in me, you know?

fields.q: 说起来，我一直喜欢雕小木像。也许哪天我会雕一个你。
fields.en: You know, I've always liked carving little wooden statues. Maybe, one day, I'll carve you.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 说起来，我一直喜欢雕小木像。也许哪天我会雕一个你。

en.value: You know, I've always liked carving little wooden statues. Maybe, one day, I'll carve you.

fields.q: 你身体真健康，好像在哪儿都能活下去。
fields.en: You're in the pink of health. Like you could survive anywhere.
fields.name: 希蒙

q.value: 你身体真健康，好像在哪儿都能活下去。

en.value: You're in the pink of health. Like you could survive anywhere.

fields.q: 在战场上，好人总是死得最快。前一刻还在说笑，下一刻……就没了。
fields.en: In the field, nice guys always die fast. One minute, they're cracking jokes, and the next… they're gone.
fields.name: 希蒙

en.value: In the field, nice guys always die fast. One minute, they're cracking jokes, and the next… they're gone.
